**Finding: compliant (preferred).**

Section 12.3 delivers the preferred position outright: nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, or conducting business in any field or territory, and Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. I checked §12, §13 (restrictions are confined to reverse engineering, interference, security bypass and unlawful use), §24, §26 and §30 and found no competing-product, build/buy, field-of-use or territory restraint on us. The only competition restraint, §12.4, binds Vendor in our favour, so it is not flagged. No redline proposed.
